set.body:
Scheduling lane: maintenance. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Retained with its original acceptance scope; recheck against current code before implementation or closure. Not a prerequisite for the annotation-assisted preview.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 0 item 2, §5 item 2.

Disk is at 91%. .worktrees holds four merged, clean registered worktrees (ladder-run, own-the-metric, perception-first-court, rootseg) and six unregistered clones (feature-values-dev, filmfestival-evaluation, filmfestival-trace-run, feature-atlas-dev, feature-grakern-ref, feature-intaglio-ref), about 16 GB.

Scope:
Remove only what the owner approves, only after every check below passes for that directory.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The owner's OK naming the exact directory list is recorded as a decision note before any deletion.
2. For each directory: no process has its working directory inside it (lsof result recorded).
3. For each directory: every branch tip and stash is reachable from a main-repo ref (`git for-each-ref --contains`), or listed as owner-dropped.
4. Ignored non-build files are digest-audited against the data root and the main tree; unique material (e.g. perception-first-court/tmp/, 144 MB) is moved into the data root or listed as owner-dropped.
5. Registered worktrees are removed with `git worktree remove` then `git worktree prune`.
6. feature-grakern-ref is removed only after docs/calibration/2026-09-04-mutations.json is re-pointed to grakern's origin commit d736dc5 and committed.
7. df before and after, and the final `git worktree list`, are recorded in the closing note.

Gate: fresh-context cold review of the committed text; the commit body states what changed and
what it does not establish.

Size: S.
set.title: [maintenance] Phase 0: free disk by removing merged worktrees and redundant clones (owner OK required first)
